record.taxonomyNotes: previously included P. armillatus and P. minor, although this arrangement has not received widespread support and some authors maintain both species under P. volans
record.taxonomyNotesCitation: Jackson, S. 2012. Gliding Mammals of the World. CSIRO Publishing, Collingwood, 215 pp. a#64138|Jackson, S. and Groves, C.P. 2015. Taxonomy of Australian Mammals. CSIRO Publishing, Clayton South, 529 pp. a#34474|McGregor, D.C., Padovan, A., Georges, A., Krockenberger, A., Yoon, H.-J. and Youngentob, K.N. 2020. Genetic evidence supports three previously described species of greater glider, _Petauroides volans_, _P. minor_, and _P. armillatus_. Scientific Reports 10(1):19284. doi:10.1038/s41598-020-76364-z

decision: Retain Petauroides volans under the cited MDD treatment for the source record in Australia Oriental. Interpret the broad game region as compatible southeastern/eastern eucalypt forest subareas, not every part of eastern Australia. No inferred records for P. minor or P. armillatus, and no extra identities.
scope: Identity treatment resolved for the existing source concept; species ecology and graphical profile still pending production integration.
